# gyro_storage_bucket_alert (Resource)

Fill alert of a Gyro Object Storage / Protected Storage bucket: one e-mail to the account owner when the bucket's usage reaches the threshold. It re-arms when usage drops below 95 % of the threshold, so the next crossing e-mails again. Checked every 5 minutes. Protected Storage counts old versions and delete markers too. One alert per bucket; destroy removes the alert (no data is deleted).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# E-mail once when the bucket reaches 80 % of the package (again after it drops below 95 % of that and fills up again).
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_alert" "assets_full" {
  service_id = 456
  bucket     = gyro_storage_bucket.assets.full_name
  type       = "percent"
  value      = 80
}

# Or an absolute size: e-mail when the "gyro-proje-yedek" bucket reaches 200 GB.
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_alert" "backup_200gb" {
  service_id = 456
  bucket     = "gyro-proje-yedek"
  type       = "gb"
  value      = 200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `service_id` (Number) Object / Protected Storage service id.
- `type` (String) percent = share of the package size, gb = absolute size.
- `value` (Number) percent: 1-100; gb: 1 - package size in GB.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <service_id>/<bucket>
- `last_sent_at` (String) Time of the last alert e-mail (ISO 8601) or empty.
- `state` (String) armed or triggered (e-mail sent, waiting for usage to drop below 95 % of the threshold).
- `threshold_gb` (Number) Threshold in GB (percent rules follow the package size).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<bucket>
terraform import gyro_storage_bucket_alert.assets_full 456/gyro-proje
```
